title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Judges 14: Samson's wedding at Timnah, with the lion, the honey, the riddle and the thirty men of Ashkelon.

questions.text: Where did Samson see the Philistine woman he wanted to marry?
questions.explanation: Samson went down to Timnah and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.

questions.text: What did Samson's father and mother object to about his choice?
questions.explanation: They asked why he would take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines instead of a woman from his own people.

answers.text: She was from the uncircumcised Philistines
She was much older than he was
She worshiped in the house of Dagon with her father and mother

questions.text: What roared at Samson in the vineyards of Timnah?
questions.explanation: When they came to the vineyards of Timnah, a young lion roared at him.

questions.text: With what did Samson tear the lion apart?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore the lion as he would have torn a young goat, with his bare hands.

answers.text: With a wooden club he found in the vineyard

questions.text: What did Samson find in the carcass of the lion?
questions.explanation: There was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

answers.text: A swarm of bees and honey
A snake coiled around its eggs

questions.text: How many companions were brought to be with Samson at the feast?
questions.explanation: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.
He said, "Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness."

answers.text: "From the hills comes the vine; from the vine comes the wine."
"Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness."
"What walks without feet and roars without a mouth?"
"The bee is small, but its gift is great."

questions.text: On the seventh day, what threat was made to Samson's wife to make her entice her husband?
questions.explanation: They said, "Entice your husband... lest we burn you and your father's house with fire."

answers.text: Sell her as a slave in Gaza
Drive her out of Timnah forever
Tell the lords of the Philistines what Samson had done to them
Burn her and her father's house with fire

questions.text: What did Samson say when the men of the city gave the answer to his riddle?
questions.explanation: He said, "If you hadn't plowed with my heifer, you wouldn't have found out my riddle."

answers.text: "You have answered well; take the garments that I promised you."
"My father or my mother must have told you the answer."
"Let the seven days of the feast begin again."
"If you hadn't plowed with my heifer, you wouldn't have found out my riddle."

questions.text: To which city did Samson go down to strike thirty men and take their plunder?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them.
